selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main message of this passage?
questions.answer: Loving Allah truly means following the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and the passage says the beauty and order in creation point to his messengership.

questions.question: What do we notice in the universe that starts the argument in this passage?
questions.answer: We notice beauty, decoration, and artistic order.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Maker’s wish to beautify and decorate creation?
questions.answer: It says this shows strong will and desire in the Maker for beauty.

questions.question: Why are human beings given a special place in the passage?
questions.answer: Because they are described as the conscious fruit of creation, with broad understanding and awareness.

questions.question: What is this person expected to appreciate?
questions.answer: Allah’s art in creation and His blessings.

questions.question: Name three things this excellent person does.
questions.answer: He worships Allah, appreciates His art, and gives thanks for His blessings.

questions.question: What question does the passage ask about the Creator’s treatment of this servant?
questions.answer: It asks whether it makes any sense that the Creator would stay unconcerned about such a devoted servant.

questions.question: What two final truths close the passage?
questions.answer: That Islam is the true religion before Allah, and that Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is Allah’s Messenger.

questions.question: Which action is connected in the passage with truly loving Allah?
questions.answer: Following the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What proof from the world is used to support this teaching?
questions.answer: The proof is the clear beauty and artistry seen throughout creation.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s love for the perfection seen in His works?
questions.answer: It says this love would be focused most on the created being best able to understand and honor it.

questions.question: What qualities make one person stand above other human beings in the passage?
questions.answer: Wide understanding, broad awareness, worship of Allah, appreciation of His art, and thankfulness for His blessings.

questions.question: What kind of person among humans is described as the most elevated?
questions.answer: The one with the broadest awareness who turns fully to Allah in worship and thanks.

questions.question: How does this person respond to Allah’s blessings and art?
questions.answer: He notices them, admires them, worships Allah, and thanks Him.

questions.question: Why would it be unreasonable for Allah not to speak to such a person?
questions.answer: Because Allah is generous and caring in all creation, so He would not ignore the servant who praises Him most perfectly.

questions.question: What important beliefs are stated at the end?
questions.answer: That Islam is the religion accepted by Allah and Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is His Messenger.

questions.question: What verse is given at the start of this part, and what is its basic meaning?
questions.answer: It gives a verse saying that if people love Allah, they should follow the Prophet so that Allah will love them.

questions.question: What does beautiful design in creation show about the Creator?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator wills beauty and loves to make things beautiful.

questions.question: What does the passage say this shows about the Maker’s inner quality?
questions.answer: It shows a lofty love and appreciation for perfection in His creation.

questions.question: Toward whom would this love be directed most strongly, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Toward human beings, especially the best and most aware among them.

questions.question: What does this special person do with his understanding and awareness?
questions.answer: He uses them for worshipping Allah, admiring His works, and thanking Him for His blessings.

questions.question: What is pictured by the second signboard?
questions.answer: A bright display of worship, reflection, admiration, gratitude, and faith.

questions.question: What is the second sphere mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: It is the sphere of worship, reflection, belief, admiration, and gratitude.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the one who leads this second sphere?
questions.answer: He is very near to Allah and beloved and accepted by Him.

title: 3 Point Necessity of Prophethood from Beauty and Art in the Universe
